title: Whoopie Cushions
description: Add some whimsy into your world with craftable whoopie cushions and  rainbow cushions when renamed.
body:
# Whoopie Cushions
- Adds crafting recipes to make cushions into red whoopie cushions using the recipe below.
  
- Adds rainbow cushions made by using an anvil to rename a cushion's name into jeb_.
  
- Rainbow cushions go through the different cushion colors in a set pattern. 

## Additional Info

1. Currently only for 26.3 snapshot 3 due to it being the version that added cushions.

<details>
<summary>Whoopie Cushion Recipe (Also revealed when you get a cushion)</summary>
1x Wind Charge
1x Cushion of Any Color
</details>
